name: adv_domain_untagged_fluid_pair
source:
// Two components with NO domain$ on the (P, mdot, h) bond: the untagged family
// must be internally compatible.
COMPONENT FluidBoundary(out)
  PARAM P, h, mdot
  out.P    = P
  out.h    = h
  out.mdot = mdot
END
FluidBoundary SRC(P = 300000, h = 196421, mdot = 1.0)
Throttle      TH()
Sink          SK()
connect(SRC.out, TH.in)
connect(TH.out, SK.in)
m = SK.mdot
h = SK.h
p = SK.P

error.message: There are 17 equations and 18 variables. The problem is underspecified and cannot be solved. Free quantity (no defining relation): sk.p. Coupled to: p, sk.in.p, th.out.p. A common cause: an element chain with no constitutive law for that quantity — e.g. an efficiency-only machine or rigid pass-through between boundaries leaves its through-flow or a port pressure free; add an orifice/valve/flow-map element or pin a boundary value.
